name: WeChat Channels

disclosure.zh: 视频号没有个人可用的发布 API，这里用视频号助手网页（微信扫码登录）。内容含 AI 生成 / 合成的画面或声音时，按《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》在发表页的声明里标注（若有「内容由 AI 生成」选项请勾选）。原创声明、位置、合集、活动由你决定。
disclosure.en: WeChat Channels has no publishing API for individuals, so this uses the Channels Assistant web page (log in by scanning the QR code with WeChat). If the video contains AI-generated or synthesized images or audio, label it in the declaration on the publish page (China's AI-content labelling rules). Original declaration, location, collection and events are your choice.

guide.zh: 打开「发表视频」页，应用放入视频、填短标题和描述（#话题 在描述末尾）。封面在视频上传后由你选。最后由你点「发表」。
guide.en: On the Post video page the app adds the video, the short title and the description (#topics at the end). Choose the cover yourself after the upload, then press 发表 (Post) yourself.

zh: 位置 / 合集 / 活动

notes: UNVERIFIED selectors (written without a logged-in session, 2026-10): the assistant renders inside a micro-frontend (shadow DOM); the fill searches open shadow roots. Check selectors on the live page and set status to verified + lastVerified.
Short title limit 16 is from third-party guides; the page shows the real limit.
Typing # in the description may open a topic picker; the tags are typed as plain #text at the end.
